print_schedule.desc: Cockpit / nose section
Fuselage mid-section — canonical Serenity belly geometry, NO belly scoop. Replaces s_middle_intake_shell24.stl for Rev N/O 4-radial-intake build.
print_schedule.notes: Generate STL from SCAD with OpenSCAD CLI: openscad -o middle_canonical_shell24.stl serenity/stl/middle_canonical_shell24.scad

print_schedule.desc: Cargo section — Rev S shell with clamshell door cutout and servo mounts
print_schedule.notes: Rev S (2026-06-01): belly opening 100×90 mm at station 165..330 mm (axial 165 mm span); 2× hinge-pin blocks (3.3 mm bore + M3 grub-screw tap) at port/stbd flanges; 2× SG90 servo mount pads (4× M2.5 pilot holes each); 4× latch-catch lips at Z=42 mm and Z=122 mm per frame edge. Mass ~15 g less than Rev O shell due to door opening cutout. Regenerate from updated SCAD before slicing.

print_schedule.desc: Rear fuselage / engine bell section with 4 radial scoop windows at neck station (~310 mm from nose). 4 rectangular cutouts (65 mm wide × 60 mm axial) at 90° spacing (dorsal/port/ventral/stbd). Canonical shell geometry otherwise preserved.
print_schedule.notes: Generate STL from SCAD. Verify scoop-window station alignment in slicer before printing; adjust NECK_X parameter if needed.

print_schedule.desc: CF-PETG structural intake frame ring — bonds into 4 scoop windows at neck station. Provides aerodynamic intake lips, registration tongues (5 mm), bonding shoulders (5 mm), and internal duct arms routing air toward plenum. Replaces structural stiffness lost by cutting hull openings.
print_schedule.notes: Print with hardened-steel nozzle. Bond with structural epoxy (e.g. West System 105/206) into hull scoop cutouts. Cure 24 h before foam-fill.

print_schedule.desc: PETG plenum manifold — collects air from the reduced-area intake duct arms (station ~310 mm) and delivers to the 55 mm EDF fan face (station ~430 mm); discharge side carries 4 RCS bleed taps (~15% mass flow) to the RCS distribution manifold. REQUIRES REGENERATION for 55 mm + RCS (Rev R1 — old 120 mm version superseded).
print_schedule.notes: PHASE 11 DEFERRED. Bond aft end to EDF mount ring; bond forward arm ends to intake frame duct arm exits; route 4 RCS bleed taps to rcs_distribution_manifold.stl. Seal all joints with epoxy fillet. Pressure-test with shop vac before closing hull.

print_schedule.desc: Wing pair (both sides, one print)
Port nacelle with integrated CW stator (SWIRL_DIR=+1) — Rev O, generated by blender_nacelle_revo.py OR openscad -D SWIRL_DIR=1 nacelle_pod_50mm_tandem.scad
print_schedule.notes: Rev O: pivot at Z=83 mm (CG). EDF bore ID≈55 mm; 11-fin twisted stator Z=75..95 mm; clevis MF104ZZ × 2; M=1.0 gear bosses at Z=83 mm and Z=133 mm. Print with hardened-steel nozzle.

print_schedule.desc: Starboard nacelle with integrated CCW stator (SWIRL_DIR=−1) — Rev O, mirror image of port nacelle
print_schedule.notes: Rev O: openscad -D SWIRL_DIR=-1. CCW stator cancels port torque reaction. Same CG pivot at Z=83 mm.

print_schedule.desc: Nacelle pivot housing outer — updated for Rev O MF104ZZ bearing at Z=83 mm
Pivot pin holders
Tilt piston linkage (decorative / fairing)
Pivot arm — carries tilt servo pushrod
Nacelle iris nozzle petal (50 mm EDF, hull-matched outer surface) — redesigned for M=1.0 crown-pinion rack in Rev O
print_schedule.notes: 8 per nacelle × 2 nacelles; print flat; inner concave face print in translucent-blue PETG for LED backlight effect. SCAD: nacelle_nozzle_iris.scad

print_schedule.desc: Nacelle iris base ring (fixed, seats at nozzle exit face) — M=1.0 internal rack for crown pinion in Rev O
print_schedule.notes: Rev O: M=1.0 internal rack tooth profile on inner ring (R_eff=28 mm). SCAD: nacelle_nozzle_iris.scad

print_schedule.desc: Fixed canonical Serenity tail nozzle (55 mm EDF) — elliptical exit 2.06×1.76 in (52.3×44.7 mm, ~1836 mm²). NO iris, NO servo; blends into hull outer mold line. PHASE 11 DEFERRED; REQUIRES GENERATION (Rev R1 — supersedes iris rear_nozzle_frame/petal).
print_schedule.notes: Phase 11 deferred. Bond to tail-cone exit; canonical exterior. WS2812B LED ring at exit lip.

print_schedule.desc: RCS bleed-air jet nozzle, fed from the EDF plenum via the RCS manifold. PHASE 11 DEFERRED; REQUIRES GENERATION (Rev R1).
print_schedule.notes: 4 per aircraft; pitch/yaw attitude authority. Phase 11 deferred.

print_schedule.desc: 4-way RCS bleed manifold off the EDF plenum (~15% mass flow split). PHASE 11 DEFERRED; REQUIRES GENERATION (Rev R1).
print_schedule.notes: Feeds the 4 RCS proportional valves. Phase 11 deferred.

print_schedule.desc: Landing gear feet (×4 in one STL)
Landing gear legs
Port clamshell cargo door — CF-PETG, bilinear-interpolated from belly hull faces
print_schedule.notes: Rev P new (PR #22 2026-06-01). Generated by generate_cargo_doors.py (trimesh/scipy bilinear interpolation from Rev O belly faces). Outer surface blends into adjacent hull skin. 8-barrel piano hinge tab on aft edge; 3 mm CF rod bore 3.15 mm; inner face has 2×2 mm foam gasket channel. Print with hardened-steel nozzle.

print_schedule.desc: Starboard clamshell cargo door — CF-PETG, mirror of port door
print_schedule.notes: Rev P new (PR #22 2026-06-01). Mirror of cargo_door_port.stl. Print in same orientation with supports on hinge tab. Watertight geometry verified.

print_schedule.desc: Winch port pedestal — CF-PETG axle clamp + MR84ZZ bearing seat + STS3215 case cradle
print_schedule.notes: Rev S (2026-07-27). SUPERSEDES cargo_winch_motor_mount.stl. Clamps the fixed Ø4 mm axle in a split collar (M3 pinch screw) and carries the port bearing seat; STS3215 drives through a lost-motion dog coupler so no radial load reaches the servo output. Servo case envelope PARAMETERISED — confirm against the STS3215 datasheet before STL generation (docs/CARGO_WINCH_SPECIFICATION.md §3.1 gate).

print_schedule.desc: Winch starboard pedestal — CF-PETG axle clamp + bearing seat + pawl pivot + solenoid mount
print_schedule.notes: Rev S (2026-07-27). Second of the two spool supports (spool is supported at BOTH ends, not cantilevered). Carries the M2 pawl pivot dowel, the set-screw-adjustable pawl spring seat, and the catch solenoid.

print_schedule.desc: Dyneema winch spool Rev 2 — CF-PETG, twin bearing counterbores + integral 24-tooth ratchet ring, NO anchor slot
print_schedule.notes: Rev S (2026-07-27). SUPERSEDES cargo_winch_spool.stl. Core OD 20 mm / usable width 18 mm / flange OD 26 mm carried forward (1500 mm capacity ≈ 24 turns). N20 3.15 mm D-bore and M2 set-screw DELETED; 2× Ø8×3 mm MR84ZZ counterbores ADDED; Ø30 mm × 3 mm sawtooth ratchet ring ADDED to the outboard stbd flange. Dyneema anchor slot DELETED so the line runs off the drum at overload (line-shed requirement). WEAR ITEM / SACRIFICIAL: the hub carries the friction slip interface (T_slip = 0.060 N.m) that protects the servo at overload. Deliberately the cheapest part in the load path — replacing a printed spool beats replacing a digital servo. Keep a spare in the field kit; inspect the slip witness-mark after any shed event. Spec §3.8.

print_schedule.desc: Winch ratchet pawl lever — CF-PETG
print_schedule.notes: Rev S (2026-07-27). 18 mm pivot-to-tooth, spring seat at 15 mm. Normally engaged: retract-free, pay-out-locked. 8° undercut on the locking face cams the pawl out above the 8.0 N slip threshold, giving powerless slow pay-out.

print_schedule.desc: Winch servo dog coupler — CF-PETG lost-motion drive
print_schedule.notes: Rev S (2026-07-27). Transmits torque only from the STS3215 output spline to the spool port flange; radial clearance keeps line load off the servo output bearing.

print_schedule.desc: Winch line fairlead — PETG, 10 mm throat radius
print_schedule.notes: Rev S (2026-07-27). Guides the Dyneema off the drum and prevents a shed line from wedging between flange and pedestal.

print_schedule.desc: Cargo door SG90 servo bracket — CF-PETG, mounts to port inner hull rib via M2.5 screws
print_schedule.notes: Rev P new (PR #21 2026-05-30). SG90 servo body pocket + 2× M2 screw retention holes; pushrod slot guides 1 mm music wire to door cam; CF-PETG for rigidity under door inertia load.

print_schedule.desc: Cargo release SG90 servo bracket — CF-PETG, mounts to starboard inner hull rib
print_schedule.notes: Rev P new (PR #21 2026-05-30). Mirrors door servo bracket geometry. Drives cradle pull-wire for payload release via 1 mm music wire in 2 mm PTFE guide tube to latch tab.

print_schedule.desc: DRV8833 breakout tray — PETG friction-fit pocket in starboard forward cargo frame
print_schedule.notes: Rev P new (PR #21 2026-05-30). Holds DRV8833 breakout PCB (23×19 mm); 4× snap tabs; JST-PH 2 mm connector cutout on long edge; 3 mm clearance from frame wall for thermal dissipation.

print_schedule.desc: Cargo payload cradle with auto-latch mechanism — PETG
print_schedule.notes: Rev P new (PR #21 2026-05-30). Payload press-to-lock auto-latch; spring-loaded lever (0.5 mm SS spring wire); pull-wire release from release servo (cargo_release_servo_bracket.stl); compatible with 50×50×30 mm+ payload footprint; rated hold 5 N minimum.

print_schedule.desc: GPS patch antenna retention ring — PETG, bonds to closed door inner face
print_schedule.notes: Rev P new (PR #21 2026-05-30). 25 mm dia opening aligned to GPS patch footprint; 3 mm lip catches antenna PCB edge; PETG acceptable — non-structural, non-RF-attenuating.

print_schedule.desc: FPV camera bezel — PETG, mounts on forward cargo bay bulkhead, pointing down at payload
print_schedule.notes: Rev P new (PR #21 2026-05-30). 28 mm dia FOV cutout; accepts standard 28 mm M12 lens FPV module; 4× M2 mounting screws to forward bulkhead; camera cable routes to Cape-B MIPI/USB.

print_schedule.desc: Combined bow sensor faceplate — single CF-PETG plate on the 40-deg nose flat carrying camera (PORT) + laser exit (CL) + ToF (STARBOARD); replaces the modeller's two camera bumps and the superseded separate bezels
print_schedule.notes: Rev R1c new (2026-06-30, TODO.md §1.1.1.1a). SCAD airframe/openscad/fuselage/bow_sensor_faceplate.scad. 28x16x2.5 mm plate, seats in bow_face_seat (bumps shaved to the 40-deg flat + 4x M2 inserts). Apertures: camera 10 mm, laser exit 6 mm, ToF 8 mm + rear 8.4 mm PMMA disc counterbore. 4x M2 flathead from exterior into seat inserts. Verified on 40-deg flat by tools/verify_bow_pod.py (3/3 bores on skin). Measured solid volume 0.65 cm3; mass 0.03 oz (0.83 g) at CF-PETG ~1.29 g/cm3 — confirm in slicer.

nacelle_edfs.desc: 50 mm EDF unit @ 6S — 4 total (2 per nacelle, tandem series)
nacelle_edfs.config: 2 per nacelle in tandem/series — single shared bore, EDF1 upstream Z=22..72 mm, EDF2 downstream Z=98..143 mm
nacelle_edfs.rotation: Port nacelle: CW from intake | Starboard nacelle: CCW from intake (counter-rotating pair for zero net torque)
nacelle_edfs.notes: Verify rotation direction before installing in nacelle. Spin-test on bench first.

nacelle_escs.desc: 40A 6S BLHeli32 ESC with BDSHOT telemetry — one per 50 mm EDF
nacelle_escs.notes: ESC1/ESC2 in port nacelle hub bore; ESC3/ESC4 in starboard. Route leads through integrated hub bore (ID=20 mm).

nacelle_stators.desc: 11-fin twisted inter-stage stator — integral to nacelle shell print (CF-PETG), not a separate part. Rev O: stator at Z=75..95 mm, 11 fins, 33° vane angle.
nacelle_stators.notes: Generated by blender_nacelle_revo.py OR nacelle_pod_50mm_tandem.scad. 11-fin count chosen for mutual prime with 6-pole EDF motor (11 × 6 = 66 — avoids tonal resonance).

rear_edf.desc: 55 mm EDF unit @ 6S — rear fuselage inside tail cone, exhaust straight aft through fixed canonical elliptical nozzle. PHASE 11 DEFERRED.
rear_edf.thrust_axis: horizontal (forward/cruise) only — NOT counted in hover T/W (canonical nozzle fires aft)
rear_edf.location: Panel F tail cone, fan face at station ~430 mm from nose. Axis aligned with fuselage centreline, intake forward (toward nose).
rear_edf.intake: reduced-area neck scoops at station ~310 mm via neck_intake_frame + aft_edf_plenum (sized for 55 mm fan).
rear_edf.rcs: feeds 4 RCS bleed-air thrusters (~15% mass flow) via rcs_distribution_manifold for pitch/yaw attitude authority; remaining ~85% exits the canonical nozzle as forward thrust.
rear_edf.nozzle: rear_nozzle_canonical.stl — fixed canonical elliptical exit 2.06×1.76 in (52.3×44.7 mm, ~1836 mm²); no iris, no servo.
rear_edf.notes: Fan area ≈2376 mm²; reduced-area scoop capture ≈3090 mm² (ratio ~1.3× duct match). All rear-EDF geometry REQUIRES REGENERATION for the 55 mm fan + canonical nozzle + RCS (Rev R1).

rear_esc.desc: 50A 6S BLHeli32 ESC for 55 mm rear EDF. PHASE 11 DEFERRED.

rcs_system.desc: 4 EDF-fed reaction-control bleed-air thrusters for pitch/yaw attitude authority. PHASE 11 DEFERRED.
rcs_system.valves: 4× SG90-class proportional valve servos (ref SERVO-RCS-VALVE) on the 6 V servo rail
rcs_system.flow_split: ~15% of EDF mass flow (~225 g equivalent), modulated per jet
rcs_system.mapping: 2 jets pitch + 2 jets yaw via FC attitude mixer

thrust_summary.note_axis: nacelle thrust is vertical (hover); rear EDF thrust is horizontal (cruise) — NOT summed.
thrust_summary.phase_11_hover_tw: ~1.43 (4464 / 3130 — rear EDF not counted; above 1.0 floor, below 1.5 comfort target)
thrust_summary.notes: Rev R1: rear EDF changed 120 mm→55 mm with fixed canonical nozzle + 4 RCS jets; rear-EDF system mass ~840 g→~360 g; Phase 11 value is cruise/range + attitude authority, not hover lift.

nacelle_tilt_servos.desc: Nacelle tilt servo — fuselage mounted, one per nacelle
nacelle_tilt_servos.type: Digital, metal gear (e.g. DS3218MG class or equivalent ≥25 kg·cm at 6V)
nacelle_tilt_servos.notes: Rev O: Servo torque demand greatly reduced by CG-pivot at Z=83 mm. At any tilt angle, gravity exerts zero net moment on the nacelle. Servo now only overcomes aerodynamic and inertia moments.

nozzle_gear_linkage.desc: Passive mechanical linkage — nacelle nozzle driven by tilt pivot, no dedicated servo. Rev O: M=1.0 gears throughout.
nozzle_gear_linkage.mechanism: Sector gear (R=22 mm, M=1.0, fixed to tilt bracket) → Drive Pinion A (N=12T, R=6 mm, on nacelle body at PIVOT_Z) → longitudinal 3 mm CF shaft in conduit → M=1.0 Bevel pair (N=14T, 45° pitch cone, 90° axis redirect) → Crown Pinion (N=12T, R=6 mm) → Nozzle inner ring rack (M=1.0, R_eff=28 mm)
nozzle_gear_linkage.gear_ratio: Sector:pinion = 22/6 = 3.667:1 × bevel 1:1 × crown:rack = 6/28 = 0.214 → effective 0.786 nozzle-deg per nacelle-deg
nozzle_gear_linkage.nozzle_state: 0° nacelle → nozzle fully closed (hull-matched petal surface); 90° nacelle → nozzle ~70.7° ring rotation = fully open
nozzle_gear_linkage.nozzle_120deg: At 120° nacelle, nozzle ring would be over-driven — internal hard stop in ring gear limits ring to 70.7° max.

pivot_bearings.desc: MF104ZZ flanged bearing 4×10×4 mm — nacelle pivot (2 per nacelle). Rev O: confirmed selection; replaces v1 686ZZ (6 mm ID).
pivot_bearings.notes: Press-fit into CLEVIS_EAR_OD=16 mm bore; pivot rod = 4 mm CF (CF-ROD-4MM)

pivot_rod.desc: 4 mm OD solid carbon-fibre pivot rod, cut to length per pivot housing drawing

sector_gear.desc: M=1.0 sector gear R=22 mm, 38T arc, 155° arc span — fixed to tilt bracket (fuselage side).

bevel_pair.desc: M=1.0 bevel gear pair N=14T each, 45° pitch cone, 1:1 ratio, 90° axis redirect.

pinion.desc: M=1.0 drive and crown pinions, N=12T, R=6 mm.

nacelle_nozzles.desc: 2× iris nozzles (one per nacelle) — gear-driven passively from tilt pivot, NO dedicated servo.
nacelle_nozzles.hinge_pins: 3 mm diameter × 5 mm stainless steel, one per petal
nacelle_nozzles.link_ring: Piano wire 0.8 mm bent to link ring connecting petals to nozzle inner ring
nacelle_nozzles.petal_material: PETG body + translucent-blue PETG inner face

rear_nozzle.desc: 1× FIXED canonical elliptical tail nozzle (rear 55 mm EDF) — NOT an iris, NO servo, NO petals. Exit 2.06×1.76 in (52.3×44.7 mm, ~1836 mm²). PHASE 11 DEFERRED.
rear_nozzle.actuation: none (fixed); the rear EDF flow is split between this nozzle (forward thrust) and the 4 RCS bleed jets

rcs_valves.desc: 4× SG90-class proportional valve servos modulating the 4 RCS bleed jets (pitch/yaw)

hinge_pins_total.desc: 3 mm OD × 5 mm stainless steel roll pin or solid pin
hinge_pins_total.notes: 16 for nacelle petals (8×2); rear nozzle is now fixed canonical (no petals, no hinge pins)

led_rings.notes: 2 nacelle iris ducts + 1 at the rear canonical nozzle exit lip. Nacelle inner petal faces printed in translucent-blue PETG.

components.desc: M=1.0 sector gear R=22 mm — fixed to tilt bracket, NOT rotating with nacelle

components.desc: M=1.0 Drive Pinion A — N=12T, R=6 mm, on nacelle exterior at pivot Z

distribution.servo_bus: 6V regulated from 6S BEC — nacelle tilt servos + rear nozzle servo

distribution.led_bus: 5V from BEC — WS2812B LED rings (3× nozzle backlight)
distribution.bec_spec: ≥5A dual BEC (5V + 6V output) on main power distribution board

wiring.esc_motor: 16AWG silicone — each ESC to EDF motor
wiring.signal: 28AWG shielded twisted pair for servo signal + DSHOT leads
wiring.data_bus: PTFE 3 mm ID conduit, full hull length, for CAN FD / RS-485 / 1553 / ETH
wiring.cargo_signal: 28AWG 3-core silicone — Cape-B GPIO to DRV8833 tray (PWM + DIR + GND), ~250 mm run (door/release servos). WINCH IS SEPARATE: CAN-PERIPH-GW J_FLEX -> STS3215 TTL bus + catch solenoid FET gate + HX711; gateway reaches the airframe only over its isolated CAN-FD/RS-485 trunks.

keel.notes: Runs full hull length; datum marks at 91, 165, 251, 320, 388 mm from nose

spars.desc: Carbon-fibre tube 12 mm OD × 1.5 mm wall
spars.length_mm: 2× 350 mm (wing spar through wing root to fuselage)

ring_frames.desc: 2 mm CF plate, 5 station profiles (91, 165, 251, 320, 388 mm from nose)

foam_fill.spec: 2 lb/ft³ (32 kg/m³) two-part closed-cell polyurethane, 4× expansion ratio
foam_fill.volume_l: ~0.7 L mixed (fills hull void after EPS void formers placed for bays + cargo)
foam_fill.notes: Provides structural rigidity, crash absorption, and near-neutral buoyancy. Do NOT foam the nacelle interior or open cargo bay section.

cargo.bay_opening_mm: 100 × 90 mm (port-to-stbd width × depth) at station 165..330 mm from nose (axial span 165 mm)
cargo.bay_usable_mm: ~90 × 80 × 135 mm (interior clearance with doors closed — accounting for door skin thickness and cradle footprint)

door_mechanism.type: Clamshell — port and starboard CF-PETG doors (cargo_door_port/stbd.stl)
door_mechanism.hinge: 8-barrel piano hinge, 3 mm CF rod bore (3.15 mm) in hull flange hinge-pin blocks
door_mechanism.hinge_rod: 3 mm CF rod × 165 mm, one per door; cut from SHAFT-CF-3MM stock
door_mechanism.seal: 3M foam gasket tape 2×2 mm in door mating flange grooves; dust and weather seal
door_mechanism.actuation: SG90 micro servo per door (Ch-A = port door open/close); cam-driven via 1 mm music wire pushrod; lever arm ~30 mm → ~0.5 N push at 1.8 kg·cm rated at 5V
door_mechanism.controller: DRV8833 dual H-bridge breakout on cargo_drv8833_tray.stl; Ch-A = door SG90, Ch-B = release SG90
door_mechanism.control_node: CN node (Cape-B) GPIO PWM + DIR; door-open commanded via CAN FD from elected FC master

winch.motor: STS3215 serial-bus servo (REF: STS3215-WINCH) — TTL half-duplex, ID-addressable; driven from CAN-PERIPH-GW J_FLEX FLEX_TTL_GPIO. SUPERSEDES the Rev P/Q/R N20 300RPM 6V gearmotor (N20-WINCH, deleted). Required torque >= 3.2 kgf.cm; datasheet figures REQUIRE VERIFICATION — docs/CARGO_WINCH_SPECIFICATION.md §3.1.
winch.spool: cargo_winch_spool_r2.stl — CF-PETG, core OD 20 mm / usable width 18 mm / flange OD 26 mm; rides on 2x MR84ZZ bearings on a FIXED Ø4 mm stainless axle clamped at BOTH pedestals (supported at both ends, not cantilevered on the motor shaft).
winch.support: cargo_winch_pedestal_port.stl + cargo_winch_pedestal_stbd.stl — twin pedestals; SHAFT-SS-4MM axle, FOS 6.8 in bending at the 2.5g / 20 N cargo load case.
winch.ratchet: Normally-engaged one-way safety ratchet: 24-tooth sawtooth ring integral with the stbd spool flange (OD 30 mm, 3 mm face) + cargo_winch_pawl.stl on a set-screw-adjustable 1.0 N spring. UNPOWERED = retract permitted, pay-out BLOCKED. Power required to retract the catch and allow unwind.
winch.catch_actuator: SOL-CATCH-5V pull solenoid (>= 2.5 N @ 3 mm), driven by the SAME gateway via FLEX_PWM_IO -> AO3400 N-FET + SS34 flyback; 10k gate pull-down so an undriven MCU leaves the catch ENGAGED. De-energised = fail-safe engaged.
winch.overload_shed: Slip threshold 8.0 N (2.04x the 3.92 N payload load; 48% of the 16.64 N available excess lift). 8-degree undercut on the locking tooth face cams the pawl out above threshold -> slow pay-out with NO power. Dyneema anchor slot DELETED: the inboard end is friction-retained only (~0.7 N capstan on the last 2 turns) so the line runs off the drum and falls away rather than fouling the UAV. The slip interface lives in the PRINTED SPOOL HUB (friction slipper, T_slip = 0.060 N.m), so at overload the spool breaks free of the servo and T_backdrive drops out of F_shed entirely; only T_slip < T_backdrive must hold. Sacrificial element is the printed spool, not the servo. Spec §3.8.
winch.line: Dyneema SK75 0.5 mm braid x 2 m (REF: DYNEEMA-SK75); rated break ~300 N; WLL ~60 N (5:1 SF). Unchanged from Rev R.
winch.load_cell: HX711 24-bit ADC (REF: HX711-LC) — tension monitoring, re-hosted from Cape-B onto the CAN-PERIPH-GW; feeds the sensed (secondary) overload path.
winch.position_sensing: ENC-AK7455-SPOOL on the spool itself (gateway J_ENC, SPI). Spool angle is reported whenever powered, regardless of coupler type. A powerless shed is un-telemetered by construction (no power, no encoder, no CAN). Spec §3.7.3.
winch.servo_mode: Encoded continuous-rotation (NOT position/servo: single-turn cannot express 23.2 spool turns; NOT stepper: its open-loop count becomes fiction after a hub slip). Gateway closes the position loop on the AK7455. Servo torque ceiling set BELOW T_slip so routine lifting never wears the sacrificial hub. Mode indices/registers pending the datasheet gate. Spec §3.9.
winch.maneuver_conflict: OPEN: at F_shed = 8.0 N a 2.0g manoeuvre on the slung payload reaches 0.98x threshold and 2.5g sheds it. Referred to the flight envelope — declare a ~1.5g slung-load limit, or raise F_shed to ~12 N (72% of excess lift). Spec §4.4.

payload_retention.cradle: cargo_cradle_autolatch.stl — PETG auto-latch: payload presses latch tab to lock, release servo pull-wire unlocks
payload_retention.release_servo: SG90 (SERVO-CARGO Ch-B) via DRV8833 Ch-B; bracket: cargo_release_servo_bracket.stl

instrumentation.gps_retention: cargo_gps_retention_ring.stl — PETG, 25 mm dia opening aligned to GPS patch; bonds to closed door inner face
instrumentation.fpv_camera: cargo_fpv_bezel.stl — PETG, 28 mm dia cutout on forward cargo bay bulkhead; camera points down at payload; connects to Cape-B MIPI/USB

cargo_electronics.desc: SG90 9g micro servo — cargo door actuation (1×) + payload release (1×)
cargo_electronics.notes: Ch-A servo = door cam; Ch-B servo = latch pull-wire release; both driven via DRV8833 H-bridge controlled by Cape-B GPIO

cargo_electronics.desc: DRV8833 dual H-bridge motor driver breakout — controls 2× SG90 cargo servos
cargo_electronics.search: DRV8833 dual H-bridge motor driver breakout board
cargo_electronics.notes: Treats SG90 servos as DC motors in position control; over-current protection prevents door-jam damage; mounts in cargo_drv8833_tray.stl; controlled via Cape-B GPIO

cargo_hardware.desc: STS3215 serial-bus servo — cargo winch drive
cargo_hardware.notes: SUPERSEDES N20-WINCH. TTL half-duplex bus servo (not PWM). Mass 60 g ASSUMED and torque/stall current UNVERIFIED — datasheet at docs/references/108090023_STS3215-C001_Datasheet.pdf is a scanned/CID-encoded PDF that could not be extracted; confirm before ordering. Required torque >= 3.2 kgf.cm.

cargo_hardware.desc: Pull-type linear solenoid — ratchet catch retract
cargo_hardware.notes: De-energised = pawl spring-engaged (fail-safe). Energised only during pay-out (~1.1 W). Driven by CAN-PERIPH-GW FLEX_PWM_IO via AO3400 N-FET.
Pressed into the spool hub counterbores, one per flange — this is what supports the spool at both ends. 10 N per bearing vs ~130 N static rating (FOS ~13).

cargo_hardware.desc: AKM AK7455 off-axis magnetic angle sensor + diametric magnet — winch spool position
cargo_hardware.notes: REF-SENSOR-008, fleet-standard (nacelle tilt). Reads spool angle DIRECTLY, independent of the servo, via the CAN-PERIPH-GW existing J_ENC 7-pad pigtail header on its dedicated SPI bus — no new part number and no board change. Needed because the servo encoder cannot be relied on for spool position: it wraps ~23x over a 1500 mm pay-out, can be outrun above ~840 Hz in a snag release, and does not rotate at all if the coupler ends up a slip clutch. See docs/CARGO_WINCH_SPECIFICATION.md §3.7.

cargo_hardware.desc: Ø4 mm A2 stainless rod x 46 mm — fixed winch axle
cargo_hardware.notes: NEW STOCK ITEM. Project stocks 3 mm CF rod (SHAFT-CF-3MM) but CF is unsuitable as a press-fit bearing race. Stationary axle, clamped in both pedestals. FOS 6.8 bending at 20 N.

cargo_hardware.desc: Compression spring, 1.0 N +/- 0.2 N at installed length, stainless
cargo_hardware.notes: Sets the ratchet slip threshold. Seated on a set-screw-adjustable seat in the stbd pedestal; bench-calibrate to 8.0 N +/- 1.0 N measured at the line.

cargo_hardware.desc: M2 x 10 mm A2 stainless dowel — pawl pivot
cargo_hardware.notes: Pawl pivot in the stbd pedestal.

cargo_hardware.desc: SS34 Schottky flyback diode — solenoid coil
cargo_hardware.notes: Across SOL-CATCH-5V; protects the AO3400 on de-energise.

cargo_hardware.desc: Dyneema SK75 0.5 mm braided line × 2 m — cargo winch spool line
cargo_hardware.search: Dyneema SK75 0.5 mm braided fishing line 100 m spool
cargo_hardware.notes: Buy 100 m spool and cut 2 m; remainder useful for structural lashing and safety tethers; WLL ~60 N (5:1 SF) — adequate for 400 g payload at 1 g = 4 N

cargo_hardware.desc: 3M foam gasket tape 2×2 mm — cargo door mating flange weather seal
cargo_hardware.search: 3M foam double-sided tape 2 mm wide closed-cell weatherseal
cargo_hardware.notes: Applied to 2×2 mm door flange groove; dust and moisture seal; max compression 50% — do not overtighten latch; replace if adhesion fails after repeated door cycles

bow_sensor_pod.desc: Forward-facing bow sensor pod on the 40-deg nose mounting flat (Rev R1c): camera on the PORT camera-bump, ToF on the STARBOARD camera-bump, crosshair laser on CL between them; all bores normal to the flat, covered by one combined faceplate (bow_sensor_faceplate.stl). Replaces the modeller's two convex camera bumps. SCAD: airframe/openscad/fuselage/bow_sensor_pod.scad. Aperture placement verified against the baked canonical head shell by tools/verify_bow_pod.py (3/3 bores on skin, walls >=2.2 mm; ToF over-runs the flat ~1.3 mm onto the roll-off, bridged by the faceplate).

items.desc: Bow camera — RunCam Nano 4 (19 mm Nano), forward video to Inara's stack
Benewake TFmini-S long-range ToF (12 m indoor / 7 m outdoor, 100 Hz, UART/I2C) to Shepherd Wash UART2
12 mm crosshair laser module, <=5 mW 650 nm Class 3R, 30 deg below horizon on CL; GPIO-enabled via 2N7002 with key-switch interlock
items.notes: Mass is a COTS-supplier estimate; varies by module.

items.desc: PMMA disc window for ToF aperture — 8 mm dia x 2 mm, uncoated (transmits 905 nm IR)
PMMA exit window for laser — 5 mm dia x 2 mm (optional; sealed modules may omit)
Printed combined bow faceplate (CF-PETG), camera+laser+ToF in one plate
Wiring/connectors — TFmini-S 28 AWG 4-cond loom to Shepherd's Room, RG178 camera coax to Inara, laser GPIO/MOSFET lead

bow_sensor_pod.notes: Total bow-pod mass addition ~= 0.80 oz (22.6 g) [imperial-primary]. Faceplate mass is a measured solid-volume estimate at CF-PETG ~1.29 g/cm3 (confirm in slicer); camera/laser sensor masses are COTS-supplier figures. Net AUW change vs the modeller's two convex bumps is essentially nil (bumps removed, ~0.8 g faceplate added). Earlier TODO estimate ~25.6 g used a ~4 g twin-bezel placeholder now superseded by the single faceplate.

totals.print_time_est_h: ~65–90 h across all parts (Rev P adds ~5–10 h cargo prints vs Rev O)
totals.filament_petg_g: ~1460 g (Rev O ~1400 g + ~54 g Rev P cargo PETG prints)
totals.filament_cfpetg_g: ~755 g (Rev O ~620 g + ~135 g Rev P cargo CF-PETG prints — 1 spool 750 g is tight; have second spool on hand)
totals.servo_breakdown: Phases 5–10 active (4): 2× nacelle tilt (≥25 kg·cm metal gear) + 2× cargo door/release (SG90). Phase 11 deferred (4): 4× RCS bleed-jet proportional valves (SG90-class). The iris rear-nozzle servo is deleted — the canonical tail nozzle is fixed.

cost_estimate_usd.hull_filament: ~$93 (Rev O $85 + ~$8 extra CF-PETG for cargo prints)
cost_estimate_usd.cargo_system_new: ~$49 (STS3215 winch servo $25 + catch solenoid $6 + 2x MR84ZZ $3 + 4mm SS axle $2 + pawl spring $2 + M2 dowel $1 + SS34 $0.5 + DRV8833 $2 + Dyneema SK75 $4 + foam gasket $3). Rev S: N20-WINCH deleted, STS3215 winch train added.
cost_estimate_usd.notes: Rev P adds ~$23 vs Rev O ($1,882). Component prices as of 2026-06-01. Excludes one-time tools. Printed cargo parts ($0 marginal cost for in-house prints) not included in cost delta beyond filament.

totals.note: Rev Q: v1 capes (CAPE-A, CAPE-B, RCRS-49) qty=0/archived. All 8 positions use v2 capes. AUW ~3,590 g. T/W ~1.48. Est. total cost: ~$2,137.

rev_q_summary: Rev Q standardises all 8 avionics nodes on EMI-hardened v2 capes. Changes from Rev P: (1) All 4 FC positions now use Cape-A-2 (Bay A/B/D/E); (2) All 4 CN positions now use Cape-B-2; (3) All 4 XCVR sub-modules now use XCVR-49MHZ-2. Cape-A-1, Cape-B-1, XCVR-49MHZ-1 KiCad, gerbers, and DTS archived. Old nacelle and fuselage EDF design variants archived (see airframe/archive/). AUW impact: +~40 g. Cost impact: +~$232 (inner bays upgraded to v2).

gcs.note: Rev Q1 — Malcolm GCS (Ground Control Station). Host PC + PB2-I comms node + Cape-B-2 + XCVR-49MHZ-2. Five radio links: SiK 915 MHz, LoRa 915 MHz, WiFi 5 GHz, 49 MHz (Part 15 §15.235), Zigbee 2.4 GHz. Servo-driven two-axis antenna gimbal with AS5600 magnetic encoders. IP65 field enclosure. No external PAs (FCC-compliant). See gcs/malcolm/hardware/docs/malcolm_antenna_spec.md.
